subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supply Chains and Climate
description: A short lesson to help you apply Supply Chains and Climate.

hook.text: Supply chains generate 60% of all global carbon emissions. The product isn't the problem—the chain is.

buildup.text: From raw material extraction to manufacturing, shipping, and disposal, every step emits greenhouse gases.

discovery.text: Most of a company's emissions (80–90%) come from its supply chain, not its own direct operations.

twist.text: A company can be carbon-neutral in its offices while its suppliers pollute massively. That's greenwashing.

climax.text: Investors, customers, and regulators now demand supply chain emissions transparency—not just office emissions.

punchline.text: Your supply chain's emissions are your emissions.

quiz.question: What share of a company's total emissions typically comes from its supply chain?
